Dungeon Crawl 32x32 tiles — town NPC subset

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/dungeon-crawl-32x32-tiles
Archive: crawl-tiles Oct-5-2010.zip
Original game: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup — http://crawl.develz.org/

License: CC0 — free to use in commercial and non-commercial projects.
Attribution not required; courtesy link to the OpenGameArt page above is appreciated.

Town NPC sprites in Assets/Art/NPC/Sprites/ are composited from layer PNGs stored under
originals/ in this folder. See README.md for recipes.
